blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__acctxperiod_exchange_rate_map
      description: Account-by-period mapping to the applicable consolidated exchange rate for conversion to the primary (top-level) subsidiary
      grain: One row per account_id × accounting_period_id × from_subsidiary_id × to_subsidiary_id (duplicates possible)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__consolidated_exchange_rates
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      business_logic: '- Build period_exchange_rate_map from stg_netsuite2__consolidated_exchange_rates: - Join to stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries (as to_subsidiaries) on to_subsidiary_id to retrieve the subsidiary name and currency_id. - Join to stg_netsuite2__currencies on to_subsidiaries.currency_id to retrieve the currency symbol. - Keep only rows where to_subsidiary_id belongs to a subsidiary that has no parent (primary subsidiary). - Pass through accounting_period_id, from_subsidiary_id, to_subsidiary_id, and the three rate fields (average_rate, current_rate, historical_rate); no aggregation or sorting; duplicates are preserved. - Cross join every row in intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts with every row in period_exchange_rate_map to form all account-by-period-by-subsidiary combinations. - For each combination, set exchange_rate based on accounts.general_rate_type using case-insensitive matching: - historical → use historical_rate - current → use current_rate - average → use average_rate - any other value or null → exchange_rate is null - Carry forward to_subsidiary_name and to_subsidiary_currency_symbol from the joined subsidiary and currency records. - No additional filtering, aggregation, or ordering is applied; source duplicates are retained.'
      columns:
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period identifier from consolidated exchange rates; pass-through with original casing; nulls preserved
      - name: from_subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin subsidiary ID for conversion; pass-through from consolidated exchange rates; original casing; nulls preserved
      - name: to_subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Target subsidiary ID restricted to primary subsidiaries; non-null due to the filter; duplicates preserved
      - name: to_subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name of the target primary subsidiary from subsidiaries; original casing and spacing; null if missing
      - name: to_subsidiary_currency_symbol
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency symbol of the target primary subsidiary from currencies via subsidiaries; original casing; null if currency or symbol is missing
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from accounts; cross-joined to all period exchange rate rows; pass-through with original casing; nulls preserved
      - name: exchange_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Selected rate per account based on general_rate_type (case-insensitive): historical uses historical_rate, current uses current_rate, average uses average_rate, otherwise null; no rounding or unit changes'

agent_sql.raw_text: WITH base AS (SELECT t.*, a.name, a.type_name, a.account_number, a.is_balancesheet, a.is_leftside, a.general_rate_type, p.ending_at, p.name AS period_name, p.is_adjustment, p.is_closed, p.fiscal_year_trunc, tp.fiscal_year_trunc AS transaction_fiscal_year, tp.fiscal_calendar_id AS transaction_calendar, p.fiscal_calendar_id, s.full_name AS subsidiary_full_name, s.name AS subsidiary_name, cur.symbol AS subsidiary_currency_symbol FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts t LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods p ON p.accounting_period_id=t.reporting_accounting_period_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods tp ON tp.accounting_period_id=t.transaction_accounting_period_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries s ON s.subsidiary_id=t.subsidiary_id LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies cur ON cur.currency_id=s.currency_id WHERE a.is_balancesheet OR t.is_income_statement), presented AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet AND fiscal_year_trunc=transaction_fiscal_year AND fiscal_calendar_id=transaction_calendar THEN 'Net Income' WHEN NOT is_balancesheet THEN 'Retained Earnings' ELSE name END AS out_name, CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet AND fiscal_year_trunc=transaction_fiscal_year AND fiscal_calendar_id=transaction_calendar THEN 'Net Income' WHEN NOT is_balancesheet THEN 'Retained Earnings' ELSE type_name END AS out_type FROM base) SELECT md5(transaction_line_id||'_'||transaction_id||'_'||reporting_accounting_period_id||'_'||out_name||'_'||coalesce(CASE WHEN is_balancesheet THEN account_id END,'')) AS balance_sheet_id, transaction_id, transaction_line_id, subsidiary_id, subsidiary_full_name, subsidiary_name, subsidiary_currency_symbol, reporting_accounting_period_id AS accounting_period_id, ending_at AS accounting_period_ending, period_name AS accounting_period_name, is_adjustment AS is_accounting_period_adjustment, is_closed AS is_accounting_period_closed, account_category, out_name AS account_name, out_name AS account_display_name, out_type AS account_type_name, lower(replace(out_type,' ', '_')) AS account_type_id, CASE WHEN is_balancesheet THEN account_id END AS account_id, CASE WHEN is_balancesheet THEN account_number END AS account_number, FALSE AS is_account_intercompany, CASE WHEN is_balancesheet THEN is_leftside ELSE FALSE END AS is_account_leftside, CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet OR is_leftside IS FALSE THEN -coalesce(converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period, converted_amount_using_reporting_month) ELSE coalesce(converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period, converted_amount_using_reporting_month) END AS converted_amount, CASE WHEN NOT is_balancesheet OR is_leftside IS FALSE THEN -unconverted_amount ELSE unconverted_amount END AS transaction_amount, CASE lower(type_name) WHEN 'bank' THEN 1 WHEN 'acctrec' THEN 2 WHEN 'unbilledrec' THEN 3 WHEN 'othcurrasset' THEN 4 WHEN 'fixedasset' THEN 5 WHEN 'othasset' THEN 6 WHEN 'deferexpense' THEN 7 WHEN 'acctpay' THEN 8 WHEN 'credcard' THEN 9 WHEN 'othcurrliab' THEN 10 WHEN 'longtermliab' THEN 11 WHEN 'deferrevenue' THEN 12 WHEN 'equity' THEN 13 ELSE CASE WHEN out_name='Retained Earnings' THEN 14 WHEN out_name='Net Income' THEN 15 END END::INTEGER AS balance_sheet_sort_helper FROM presented

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__customer_credit_risk
      description: Customer credit risk assessment from transaction details and lines with receivables metrics, behavior scores, activity status, and recommendations.
      grain: One row per customer_id and subsidiary_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: '- Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Receivable, AcctRec, Income, or Bank. - Derive per row: customer_id from entity_id; customer_name as "Customer_" plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as "customer_" plus the first 8 characters and "@client.com"; customer_creation_date set to 365 days before today; customer_relationship_days fixed at 365. - Classify transaction_category: Receivable for Accounts Receivable/AcctRec, Revenue for Income, Payment for Bank, else Other. Set collection_status: Collected for Bank, Outstanding for Accounts Receivable/AcctRec, Billed for Income, else Other. - Aggregate by customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_receivables: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Receivable transactions. - total_collections: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions. - total_revenue: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Revenue transactions. - outstanding_receivables: sum of the absolute converted_amount where collection_status is Outstanding. - total_transactions: count of unique transaction_ids. - payment_transactions: count of rows where transaction_category is Payment. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows where collection_status is Outstanding. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending; last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among Outstanding; last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among Payment. - Compute metrics: - collection_ratio: total_collections divided by total_receivables when total_receivables > 0, else 0. - avg_collection_delay_days: simulated delay of 30–89 days based on a deterministic hash of customer_id when there are payment transactions, else NULL. - relationship_duration_months: months between first and last transaction plus one when both exist, else 1. - customer_activity_status: Active if last transaction is within 30 days, Recent if within 90, Dormant if within 180, else Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days from last_outstanding_date to today when present, else 0. - receivables_to_revenue_ratio: outstanding_receivables divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0. - Scoring (1–5): - payment_performance_score by collection_ratio: >=0.95→5, >=0.85→4, >=0.75→3, >=0.60→2, else 1. - payment_timeliness_score by avg_collection_delay_days: <=35→5, <=45→4, <=60→3, <=75→2, else 1 (NULL yields 1). - relationship_stability_score by relationship_duration_months: >=24→5, >=12→4, >=6→3, >=3→2, else 1. - revenue_volume_score by total_revenue: >=100000→5, >=50000→4, >=25000→3, >=10000→2, else 1. - receivables_control_score by receivables_to_revenue_ratio: <=0.10→5, <=0.20→4, <=0.30→3, <=0.40→2, else 1. - Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the five component scores. - credit_rating by total_credit_score: >=20→AAA, >=16→AA, >=12→A, >=8→BBB, else BB. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_receivables > 40% of revenue and days_since_last_outstanding > 90; Medium Risk if >30% and >60 days; Low Risk if >20% and >45 days; else Minimal Risk. - recommended_credit_limit: revenue multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 according to the same score bands as credit_rating. - collection_difficulty: Very Difficult if days_since_last_outstanding > 90 and collection_ratio < 0.7; Difficult if >60 and <0.8; Moderate if >30 and <0.9; else Easy. - risk_assessment_date: today’s date; customer_risk_id: deterministic hash of "customer_id_subsidiary_id" (NULL if subsidiary_id is missing). - Return rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from transaction lines; non-null.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic name: ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic email: ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id and ''@client.com''.'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Set to 365 days before today.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_relationship_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed at 365 days.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: relationship_duration_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Months spanned by the first to last transaction plus one; defaults to 1 if either date is missing.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; may be null.
      - name: total_receivables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Receivable transactions; always populated.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_collections
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions; always populated.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Revenue transactions; filtered to be greater than zero.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_receivables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount where collection_status is Outstanding; always populated.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: collection_ratio

        description: Total collections divided by total receivables with zero when receivables are zero.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: receivables_to_revenue_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Outstanding receivables divided by total revenue with zero when revenue is zero; final rows have revenue > 0.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: avg_collection_delay_days
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: Simulated 30–89 day delay based on a hash of customer_id when payment transactions exist; else NULL.
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique transaction_ids across all joined rows.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows classified as Payment; zero if none.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: outstanding_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows with Outstanding status; zero if none.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending per customer_id and subsidiary_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending per customer_id and subsidiary_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: last_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Payment transactions; may be null.
      - name: last_outstanding_date

        data_type: INTEGER

        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: payment_timeliness_score
        data_type: INTEGER

        - not_null

        tests:
        - not_null

        - not_null

        - unique

specification.name: int_netsuite2__customer_credit_risk
specification.description: Customer credit risk assessment from transaction details and lines with receivables metrics, behavior scores, activity status, and recommendations.
specification.grain: One row per customer_id and subsidiary_id
specification.business_logic: - Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Receivable, AcctRec, Income, or Bank. - Derive per row: customer_id from entity_id; customer_name as "Customer_" plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as "customer_" plus the first 8 characters and "@client.com"; customer_creation_date set to 365 days before today; customer_relationship_days fixed at 365. - Classify transaction_category: Receivable for Accounts Receivable/AcctRec, Revenue for Income, Payment for Bank, else Other. Set collection_status: Collected for Bank, Outstanding for Accounts Receivable/AcctRec, Billed for Income, else Other. - Aggregate by customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_receivables: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Receivable transactions. - total_collections: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions. - total_revenue: sum of the absolute converted_amount for Revenue transactions. - outstanding_receivables: sum of the absolute converted_amount where collection_status is Outstanding. - total_transactions: count of unique transaction_ids. - payment_transactions: count of rows where transaction_category is Payment. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows where collection_status is Outstanding. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending; last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among Outstanding; last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among Payment. - Compute metrics: - collection_ratio: total_collections divided by total_receivables when total_receivables > 0, else 0. - avg_collection_delay_days: simulated delay of 30–89 days based on a deterministic hash of customer_id when there are payment transactions, else NULL. - relationship_duration_months: months between first and last transaction plus one when both exist, else 1. - customer_activity_status: Active if last transaction is within 30 days, Recent if within 90, Dormant if within 180, else Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days from last_outstanding_date to today when present, else 0. - receivables_to_revenue_ratio: outstanding_receivables divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0. - Scoring (1–5): - payment_performance_score by collection_ratio: >=0.95→5, >=0.85→4, >=0.75→3, >=0.60→2, else 1. - payment_timeliness_score by avg_collection_delay_days: <=35→5, <=45→4, <=60→3, <=75→2, else 1 (NULL yields 1). - relationship_stability_score by relationship_duration_months: >=24→5, >=12→4, >=6→3, >=3→2, else 1. - revenue_volume_score by total_revenue: >=100000→5, >=50000→4, >=25000→3, >=10000→2, else 1. - receivables_control_score by receivables_to_revenue_ratio: <=0.10→5, <=0.20→4, <=0.30→3, <=0.40→2, else 1. - Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the five component scores. - credit_rating by total_credit_score: >=20→AAA, >=16→AA, >=12→A, >=8→BBB, else BB. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_receivables > 40% of revenue and days_since_last_outstanding > 90; Medium Risk if >30% and >60 days; Low Risk if >20% and >45 days; else Minimal Risk. - recommended_credit_limit: revenue multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 according to the same score bands as credit_rating. - collection_difficulty: Very Difficult if days_since_last_outstanding > 90 and collection_ratio < 0.7; Difficult if >60 and <0.8; Moderate if >30 and <0.9; else Easy. - risk_assessment_date: today’s date; customer_risk_id: deterministic hash of "customer_id_subsidiary_id" (NULL if subsidiary_id is missing). - Return rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue > 0.

intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l USING(transaction_line_id) WHERE l.entity_id IS NOT NULL AND t.account_type_name IN ('Income','COGS','Expense','OthExpense')), agg AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, (current_date-365)::TIMESTAMP customer_creation_date, 365::INTEGER customer_age_days, subsidiary_id, sum(CASE WHEN account_type_name='Income' THEN converted_amount ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE total_revenue, sum(CASE WHEN account_type_name='COGS' THEN abs(converted_amount) ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE net_margin_pct>=.2 THEN 4 WHEN net_margin_pct>=.1 THEN 3 WHEN net_margin_pct>=.05 THEN 2 WHEN net_margin_pct>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END margin_score, CASE WHEN customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_age_days, CASE WHEN customer_age_days<90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN customer_age_days<365 THEN 'Growing Relationship' WHEN customer_age_days<1095 THEN 'Established Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END customer_maturity, subsidiary_id,total_revenue,total_cogs,allocated_expenses,gross_profit,net_profit,gross_margin_pct,net_margin_pct,transaction_count,active_months,coalesce(customer_lifetime_months,1) customer_lifetime_months,first_transaction_date,last_transaction_date,average_order_value,revenue_score,frequency_score,margin_score,total_customer_score,CASE WHEN total_customer_score>=12 THEN 'Champion' WHEN total_customer_score>=9 THEN 'Loyal' WHEN total_customer_score>=6 THEN 'Potential' WHEN total_customer_score>=3 THEN 'At Risk' ELSE 'Lost' END customer_segment,activity_status,net_profit/nullif(active_months,0)*greatest(12,1.2*coalesce(customer_lifetime_months,1)) predicted_clv,CASE WHEN net_margin_pct>=.2 AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active','Active') THEN 'High Investment' WHEN net_margin_pct>=.1 AND total_revenue>(SELECT avg(total_revenue) FROM agg) THEN 'Medium Investment' WHEN net_margin_pct>0 THEN 'Low Investment' ELSE 'Review Required' END investment_recommendation,current_date analysis_date FROM final WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL AND total_revenue>0

scopes.select_sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, CAST((CURRENT_DATE - 365) AS TIMESTAMP) AS customer_creation_date, CAST(365 AS INT) AS customer_age_days, subsidiary_id, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type_name = 'Income' THEN converted_amount ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS total_revenue, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type_name = 'COGS' THEN ABS(converted_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS total_cogs, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type_name IN ('Expense', 'OthExpense') THEN ABS(converted_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS allocated_expenses, COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS transaction_count, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', accounting_period_ending)) AS active_months, MIN(accounting_period_ending) AS first_transaction_date, MAX(accounting_period_ending) AS last_transaction_date FROM tx GROUP BY ALL

SELECT *, total_revenue - total_cogs AS gross_profit, total_revenue - total_cogs - allocated_expenses AS net_profit, (total_revenue - total_cogs) / NULLIF(total_revenue, 0) AS gross_margin_pct, (total_revenue - total_cogs - allocated_expenses) / NULLIF(total_revenue, 0) AS net_margin_pct, DATE_DIFF('MONTH', first_transaction_date, last_transaction_date) + 1 AS customer_lifetime_months, total_revenue / NULLIF(transaction_count, 0) AS average_order_value FROM agg

SELECT *, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue) AS revenue_score, CASE WHEN transaction_count >= 20 THEN 5 WHEN transaction_count >= 10 THEN 4 WHEN transaction_count >= 5 THEN 3 WHEN transaction_count >= 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS frequency_score, CASE WHEN net_margin_pct >= 0.3 THEN 5 WHEN net_margin_pct >= 0.2 THEN 4 WHEN net_margin_pct >= 0.1 THEN 3 WHEN net_margin_pct >= 0.05 THEN 2 WHEN net_margin_pct > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS margin_score, CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', last_transaction_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 30 THEN 'Highly Active' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', last_transaction_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 90 THEN 'Active' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', last_transaction_date, CURRENT_DATE) <= 180 THEN 'At Risk' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS activity_status FROM metrics
SELECT *, revenue_score + frequency_score + margin_score AS total_customer_score FROM scores
SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM agg

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      description: Customer profitability metrics, scoring, and recommendations per customer and subsidiary based on converted_amount aggregations; final rows require total_revenue > 0.
      grain: One row per customer_id per subsidiary_id (after filtering to total_revenue > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build customer_transactions: - Join transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id. - Keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Income, COGS, Expense, or OthExpense. - Derive customer fields from entity_id: customer_id equals entity_id; customer_name as ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id; customer_email as ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id plus ''@example.com''. - Set customer_creation_date to the current date minus 365 days and customer_age_days to 365. - Categorize transactions by account_type_name: Income as Revenue; COGS as Cost_of_Sales; Expense and OthExpense as Operating_Expense. Aggregate to customer_metrics at the level of customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_creation_date, customer_age_days, subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions (signed). - total_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales. - allocated_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense. - gross_profit: total_revenue minus total_cogs. - net_profit: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses. - transaction_count: distinct count of transaction_id. - active_months: distinct count of calendar months from accounting_period_ending. - first_transaction_date and last_transaction_date: earliest and latest accounting_period_ending. - average_order_value: total_revenue divided by transaction_count; use 0 when transaction_count is 0. Enrich in customer_segmentation: - gross_margin_pct: gross_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - net_margin_pct: net_profit divided by total_revenue; use 0 when total_revenue is 0. - customer_lifetime_months: months between first and last transaction, inclusive; use 1 when either date is missing. - customer_maturity from customer_age_days: under 90 days is New Customer; under 365 is Growing Relationship; under 1095 is Established Customer; otherwise Long-term Customer. - activity_status from days since last_transaction_date at run time: 30 or fewer is Highly Active; 31–90 is Active; 91–180 is At Risk; over 180 is Inactive. - analysis_date equals the current date. Score in customer_value_scoring: - revenue_score: 5 for total_revenue at or above the 80th percentile; 4 at or above the 60th; 3 at or above the 40th; 2 at or above the 20th; otherwise 1. Percentiles are computed over all rows in customer_segmentation (before the final filter). - frequency_score: 5 for 20 or more transactions; 4 for 10–19; 3 for 5–9; 2 for 2–4; otherwise 1. - margin_score: 5 for net_margin_pct at or above 0.30; 4 at or above 0.20; 3 at or above 0.10; 2 at or above 0.05; 1 for greater than 0; otherwise 0. Final computations and filter: - total_customer_score equals revenue_score plus frequency_score plus margin_score. - customer_segment: Champion for scores 12 or higher; Loyal for 9–11; Potential for 6–8; At Risk for 3–5; Lost for below 3. - predicted_clv: if customer_lifetime_months and active_months are both greater than 0, multiply net_profit per month by the larger of 12 months and 1.2 times customer_lifetime_months; otherwise use net_profit. - investment_recommendation: High Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.20 and activity_status is Highly Active or Active; Medium Investment when net_margin_pct is at least 0.10 and total_revenue exceeds the average total_revenue across customer_segmentation; Low Investment when net_margin_pct is greater than 0; otherwise Review Required. - Keep rows where customer_id is present and total_revenue is greater than 0. - customer_profitability_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by customer_id, an underscore, and subsidiary_id; it is null if either component is null.'
      columns:
      - name: customer_profitability_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of customer_id + '_' + subsidiary_id; null when either component is null; unique per (customer_id, subsidiary_id).
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier from transaction lines; final rows require non-null.
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic name: ''Customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id.'
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Synthetic email: ''customer_'' plus the first 8 characters of customer_id and ''@example.com''.'
      - name: customer_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Current date minus 365 days at run time for all rows.
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 365 representing days since customer_creation_date.
      - name: customer_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket from customer_age_days: New (<90), Growing (<365), Established (<1095), Long-term (otherwise).'
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary from transaction details; may be null; part of the row grain and ID hash.
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Signed sum of converted_amount for Revenue transactions; final rows require > 0.
      - name: total_cogs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Cost_of_Sales; non-negative.
      - name: allocated_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Operating_Expense; non-negative.
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_revenue minus total_cogs; may be negative.
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: gross_profit minus allocated_expenses; may be negative.
      - name: gross_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: gross_profit divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0; ratio not a formatted percent.
      - name: net_margin_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: net_profit divided by total_revenue when total_revenue > 0, else 0; ratio not a formatted percent.
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of transaction_id across included categories; at least 1 in final rows.
      - name: active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of calendar months present in accounting_period_ending; at least 1.
      - name: customer_lifetime_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Inclusive months between first and last transaction; 1 when either date is missing.
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending for the customer and subsidiary.
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending for the customer and subsidiary.
      - name: average_order_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: total_revenue divided by transaction_count when transaction_count > 0, else 0.
      - name: revenue_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score based on total_revenue percentiles across customer_segmentation: 80th+→5, 60th+→4, 40th+→3, 20th+→2, otherwise 1.'
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from transaction_count thresholds: 20+→5; 10–19→4; 5–9→3; 2–4→2; otherwise 1.'
      - name: margin_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Score from net_margin_pct thresholds: ≥0.30→5; ≥0.20→4; ≥0.10→3; ≥0.05→2; >0→1; otherwise 0.'
      - name: total_customer_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of revenue_score, frequency_score, and margin_score.
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Segment by total_customer_score: Champion (≥12), Loyal (≥9), Potential (≥6), At Risk (≥3), Lost (otherwise).'
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recency category by days since last_transaction_date: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; otherwise Inactive.'
      - name: predicted_clv
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If customer_lifetime_months and active_months are both > 0, scale net_profit per month by the larger of 12 months or 1.2×customer_lifetime_months; otherwise use net_profit.
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High when net_margin_pct ≥ 0.20 and activity is Highly Active/Active; Medium when net_margin_pct ≥ 0.10 and total_revenue exceeds the average across customer_segmentation; Low when net_margin_pct > 0; otherwise Review Required.
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: The current date at model run, identical across all rows for the run.

agent_sql.raw_text:
WITH transaction_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Transactions' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT transaction_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(transaction_date) AS earliest_value,
        max(transaction_date) AS latest_value,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
), line_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Transaction lines' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT transaction_line_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_line_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(transaction_id) AS earliest_value,
        max(transaction_id) AS latest_value,
        0::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
), customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Customers' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT customer_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(company_name) AS earliest_value,
        max(company_name) AS latest_value,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE company_name IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE email_address IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
), table_stats AS (
    SELECT * FROM transaction_stats
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM line_stats
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM customer_stats
), integrity AS (
    SELECT 'transaction_lines_to_transactions' AS check_name,
           count(t.transaction_id)::BIGINT AS matched,
           count(*)::BIGINT AS total
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions t USING (transaction_id)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'transaction_lines_to_entities', count(e.entity_id)::BIGINT, count(*)::BIGINT
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__entities e ON e.entity_id = l.entity_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'transactions_to_entities', count(e.entity_id)::BIGINT, count(*)::BIGINT
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions t
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__entities e ON e.entity_id = t.entity_id
), assessment AS (
    SELECT
        avg(CASE
            WHEN table_name = 'Transactions' AND null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_entities = 0 THEN 100.0
            WHEN table_name = 'Customers' AND null_primary_keys + null_dates = 0 THEN 100.0
            WHEN table_name = 'Transaction lines' THEN 85.0
            ELSE 70.0
        END) AS completeness_score,
        (SELECT avg(round(100.0 * matched / nullif(total, 0), 2)) FROM integrity) AS consistency_score,
        100.0 AS accuracy_score,
        current_timestamp AS assessment_timestamp
    FROM table_stats
), report AS (
    SELECT
        'Data Quality Assessment'::VARCHAR AS report_type,
        completeness_score,
        consistency_score,
        accuracy_score,
        round((completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0, 2) AS overall_quality_score,
        CASE WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 95 THEN 'Excellent'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 85 THEN 'Good'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 70 THEN 'Fair'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 >= 50 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Critical' END::VARCHAR AS quality_grade,
        CASE WHEN completeness_score < 80 THEN 'Data Completeness Issues'
             WHEN consistency_score < 80 THEN 'Referential Integrity Issues'
             WHEN accuracy_score < 80 THEN 'Business Rule Violations' ELSE 'No Major Issues' END::VARCHAR AS primary_concern,
        CASE WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 < 70 THEN 'Immediate Data Cleansing Required'
             WHEN (completeness_score + consistency_score + accuracy_score) / 3.0 < 85 THEN 'Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended'
             ELSE 'Maintain Current Data Quality Standards' END::VARCHAR AS recommended_action,
        (SELECT count(*)::BIGINT FROM table_stats) AS tables_assessed,
        (SELECT count(*)::BIGINT FROM integrity) AS integrity_checks_performed,
        4::BIGINT AS business_rules_validated,
        assessment_timestamp,
        md5(cast(assessment_timestamp AS VARCHAR)) AS quality_assessment_id
    FROM assessment
), detail_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Table Statistics'::VARCHAR AS report_type,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS completeness_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS consistency_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS accuracy_score,
        NULL::DOUBLE AS overall_quality_score,
        table_name::VARCHAR AS quality_grade,
        ('Records: ' || total_records || ', Unique: ' || unique_records || ', Null PKs: ' || null_primary_keys)::VARCHAR AS primary_concern,
        CASE WHEN table_name = 'Transactions' THEN 'Date Range: ' || earliest_value || ' to ' || latest_value
             WHEN table_name = 'Transaction lines' THEN 'Date Range: ' || earliest_value || ' to ' || latest_value

        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_date IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE entity_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
), line_stats AS (
    SELECT
        'Transaction lines' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT transaction_line_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_line_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(transaction_id) AS earliest_value,
        max(transaction_id) AS latest_value,
        0::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines

    SELECT
        'Customers' AS table_name,
        count(*)::BIGINT AS total_records,
        count(DISTINCT customer_id)::BIGINT AS unique_records,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_primary_keys,
        min(company_name) AS earliest_value,
        max(company_name) AS latest_value,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE company_name IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE email_address IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_entities
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
), table_stats AS (
    SELECT * FROM transaction_stats
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM line_stats
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM customer_stats
), integrity AS (
    SELECT 'transaction_lines_to_transactions' AS check_name,
           count(t.transaction_id)::BIGINT AS matched,
           count(*)::BIGINT AS total
    FROM staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions t USING (transaction_id)

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics
      description: Comprehensive NetSuite data quality outputs combining an overall assessment with detailed per-table statistics and referential integrity checks
      grain: One row per report entry (overall assessment, table statistics, or integrity check)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__entities
      business_logic: 'Compile intermediate checks and summarize into a final unioned report ordered by report_type and quality_grade (ascending): - source_table_stats (per source table snapshot with current time): - Transactions: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_id; counts of null transaction_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_date (null_dates), null entity_id (null_subsidiaries), null status (null_status); earliest_date = minimum transaction_date; latest_date = maximum transaction_date. - Transaction lines: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_line_id; counts of null transaction_line_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_id (null_foreign_keys), null entity_id twice for both null_accounts and null_amounts; earliest_transaction = minimum transaction_id; latest_transaction = maximum transaction_id. - Customers: total records; unique records by distinct customer_id; counts of null customer_id (null_primary_keys), null company_name (null_names), null email_address (null_emails), null date_first_order_at (null_creation_dates); unique_names = distinct company_name count; unique_emails = distinct email_address count. - referential_integrity_checks (three left-join checks; integrity percentages rounded to two decimals): - transaction_lines_to_transactions: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined transaction_ids; orphaned = base minus matched; integrity = matched/base × 100 (two decimals); timestamp = current time. - transaction_lines_to_entities: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - transactions_to_entities: base = transactions; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - business_rule_validations (four rules; compliance percentages rounded to two decimals; timestamp = current time): - transaction_id_uniqueness: violations = total transactions minus distinct transaction_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - customer_id_uniqueness: violations = total customers minus distinct customer_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - future_transaction_dates: violations = transactions with date more than one day in the future; compliance = transactions with date not more than one day in the future divided by total × 100. - balanced_journal_entries: sum netamount per transaction_id; violations = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount greater than 0.01; compliance = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount at most 0.01 divided by total × 100. - data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output. - overall_quality_summary (single row): - completeness_score = average across source_table_stats of: for transactions, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_subsidiaries) equals 0 else 70; for customers, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70; otherwise (e.g., transaction_lines) 85. - consistency_score = average integrity_percentage across referential_integrity_checks. - accuracy_score = average compliance_percentage across business_rule_validations. - assessment_timestamp = current time. - Final output (UNION ALL): - Overall row (report_type = ''Data Quality Assessment''): - overall_quality_score = average of completeness, consistency, and accuracy scores, rounded to two decimals. - quality_grade: Excellent (>= 95), Good (>= 85), Fair (>= 70), Poor (>= 50), otherwise Critical. - primary_concern: first applicable—Data Completeness Issues if completeness_score < 80; else Referential Integrity Issues if consistency_score < 80; else Business Rule Violations if accuracy_score < 80; else No Major Issues. - recommended_action: Immediate Data Cleansing Required if overall_quality_score < 70; Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended if < 85; otherwise Maintain Current Data Quality Standards. - tables_assessed = number of source_table_stats rows; integrity_checks_performed = number of referential_integrity_checks rows; business_rules_validated = number of business_rule_validations rows. - quality_assessment_id = MD5 of the assessment_timestamp as text. - Table Statistics rows (one per source_table_stats row; report_type = ''Table Statistics''): - quality_grade = table_name. - primary_concern = "Records: {total_records}, Unique: {unique_records}, Null PKs: {null_primary_keys}". - recommended_action: - Transactions: "Date Range: {earliest_date} to {latest_date}". - Transaction lines: "Date Range: {earliest_transaction} to {latest_transaction}" (transaction_id values). - Customers: "Date Range: {unique_names} to {unique_emails}" (distinct counts occupying those positions). - If any concatenated component is null, the whole string is null. - metric columns not applicable are null; specification.name: int_netsuite2__data_quality_metrics
specification.description: Comprehensive NetSuite data quality outputs combining an overall assessment with detailed per-table statistics and referential integrity checks
specification.grain: One row per report entry (overall assessment, table statistics, or integrity check)
specification.business_logic: Compile intermediate checks and summarize into a final unioned report ordered by report_type and quality_grade (ascending): - source_table_stats (per source table snapshot with current time): - Transactions: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_id; counts of null transaction_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_date (null_dates), null entity_id (null_subsidiaries), null status (null_status); earliest_date = minimum transaction_date; latest_date = maximum transaction_date. - Transaction lines: total records; unique records by distinct transaction_line_id; counts of null transaction_line_id (null_primary_keys), null transaction_id (null_foreign_keys), null entity_id twice for both null_accounts and null_amounts; earliest_transaction = minimum transaction_id; latest_transaction = maximum transaction_id. - Customers: total records; unique records by distinct customer_id; counts of null customer_id (null_primary_keys), null company_name (null_names), null email_address (null_emails), null date_first_order_at (null_creation_dates); unique_names = distinct company_name count; unique_emails = distinct email_address count. - referential_integrity_checks (three left-join checks; integrity percentages rounded to two decimals): - transaction_lines_to_transactions: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined transaction_ids; orphaned = base minus matched; integrity = matched/base × 100 (two decimals); timestamp = current time. - transaction_lines_to_entities: base = transaction_lines; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - transactions_to_entities: base = transactions; matched = joined entity_ids; orphaned and integrity computed as above; timestamp = current time. - business_rule_validations (four rules; compliance percentages rounded to two decimals; timestamp = current time): - transaction_id_uniqueness: violations = total transactions minus distinct transaction_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - customer_id_uniqueness: violations = total customers minus distinct customer_id; compliance = distinct/total × 100. - future_transaction_dates: violations = transactions with date more than one day in the future; compliance = transactions with date not more than one day in the future divided by total × 100. - balanced_journal_entries: sum netamount per transaction_id; violations = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount greater than 0.01; compliance = distinct transactions with absolute total_amount at most 0.01 divided by total × 100. - data_completeness_analysis (customers_contact_info and transaction_lines_account_assignment) is computed but not used in final output. - overall_quality_summary (single row): - completeness_score = average across source_table_stats of: for transactions, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_dates + null_subsidiaries) equals 0 else 70; for customers, 100 if (null_primary_keys + null_names) equals 0 else 70; otherwise (e.g., transaction_lines) 85. - consistency_score = average integrity_percentage across referential_integrity_checks. - accuracy_score = average compliance_percentage across business_rule_validations. - assessment_timestamp = current time. - Final output (UNION ALL): - Overall row (report_type = 'Data Quality Assessment'): - overall_quality_score = average of completeness, consistency, and accuracy scores, rounded to two decimals. - quality_grade: Excellent (>= 95), Good (>= 85), Fair (>= 70), Poor (>= 50), otherwise Critical. - primary_concern: first applicable—Data Completeness Issues if completeness_score < 80; else Referential Integrity Issues if consistency_score < 80; else Business Rule Violations if accuracy_score < 80; else No Major Issues. - recommended_action: Immediate Data Cleansing Required if overall_quality_score < 70; Regular Data Quality Monitoring Recommended if < 85; otherwise Maintain Current Data Quality Standards. - tables_assessed = number of source_table_stats rows; integrity_checks_performed = number of referential_integrity_checks rows; business_rules_validated = number of business_rule_validations rows. - quality_assessment_id = MD5 of the assessment_timestamp as text. - Table Statistics rows (one per source_table_stats row; report_type = 'Table Statistics'): - quality_grade = table_name. - primary_concern = "Records: {total_records}, Unique: {unique_records}, Null PKs: {null_primary_keys}". - recommended_action: - Transactions: "Date Range: {earliest_date} to {latest_date}". - Transaction lines: "Date Range: {earliest_transaction} to {latest_transaction}" (transaction_id values). - Customers: "Date Range: {unique_names} to {unique_emails}" (distinct counts occupying those positions). - If any concatenated component is null, the whole string is null. - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of table_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Integrity Checks rows (one per referential_integrity_checks row; report_type = 'Integrity Checks'): - overall_quality_score = integrity_percentage (two decimals). - quality_grade = check_name. - primary_concern = "Matched: {matched}/{total}" using the matched join count over the base record count of the check. - recommended_action = "Orphaned Records: {orphaned_records}". - metric columns not applicable are null; assessment_timestamp = check_timestamp; quality_assessment_id = MD5 of check_name concatenated with check_timestamp as text. - Final ordering: by report_type then quality_grade ascending; casing and spacing in constructed strings are preserved.

scopes.select_sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN current_ratio >= 2 THEN 100 WHEN current_ratio >= 1.5 THEN 80 WHEN current_ratio >= 1 THEN 60 WHEN current_ratio >= 0.8 THEN 40 WHEN current_ratio >= 0.5 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS liquidity_score, CASE WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.15 THEN 100 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.1 THEN 80 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.05 THEN 60 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.02 THEN 40 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS profitability_score, CASE WHEN receivables_turnover >= 12 THEN 100 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 8 THEN 80 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 6 THEN 60 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 4 THEN 40 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS efficiency_score FROM ratios

cte_definitions.name: latest
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT MAX(accounting_period_ending) AS latest_date FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__balance_sheet

cte_definitions.name: bs
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id, accounting_period_ending, account_type_name, SUM(converted_amount) AS period_balance FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__balance_sheet CROSS JOIN latest WHERE accounting_period_ending = latest_date GROUP BY ALL

cte_definitions.name: assets
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id, SUM(period_balance) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name IN ('Bank', 'AcctRec', 'UnbilledRec', 'OthCurrAsset')) AS total_current_assets, SUM(period_balance) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name = 'Bank') AS cash_and_equivalents, SUM(period_balance) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name IN ('AcctRec', 'UnbilledRec')) AS accounts_receivable FROM bs GROUP BY subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id

cte_definitions.name: liabs
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id, SUM(ABS(period_balance)) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name IN ('AcctPay', 'CredCard', 'OthCurrLiab')) AS total_current_liabilities FROM bs GROUP BY subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id

cte_definitions.name: eq
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id, SUM(period_balance) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name IN ('Equity', 'Retained Earnings', 'Net Income')) AS total_equity FROM bs GROUP BY subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id

cte_definitions.name: inc
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT subsidiary_id, SUM(converted_amount) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name = 'Income') AS total_revenue, SUM(converted_amount) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name = 'COGS') AS total_cogs, SUM(converted_amount) FILTER(WHERE account_type_name IN ('Income', 'COGS', 'Expense', 'OthIncome', 'OthExpense')) AS net_income FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__income_statement WHERE accounting_period_ending >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12' MONTHS GROUP BY subsidiary_id

cte_definitions.name: ratios
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT a.*, l.total_current_liabilities, e.total_equity, i.total_revenue, i.total_cogs, i.net_income, a.total_current_assets / NULLIF(l.total_current_liabilities, 0) AS current_ratio, (a.cash_and_equivalents + a.accounts_receivable) / NULLIF(l.total_current_liabilities, 0) AS quick_ratio, a.cash_and_equivalents / NULLIF(l.total_current_liabilities, 0) AS cash_ratio, i.net_income / NULLIF(e.total_equity, 0) AS return_on_equity, (i.total_revenue - i.total_cogs) / NULLIF(i.total_revenue, 0) AS gross_margin_ratio, i.net_income / NULLIF(i.total_revenue, 0) AS net_profit_margin, i.total_revenue / NULLIF(a.accounts_receivable, 0) AS receivables_turnover FROM assets AS a LEFT JOIN liabs AS l USING (subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id) LEFT JOIN eq AS e USING (subsidiary_id, accounting_period_id) LEFT JOIN inc AS i USING (subsidiary_id)

cte_definitions.name: scores
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN current_ratio >= 2 THEN 100 WHEN current_ratio >= 1.5 THEN 80 WHEN current_ratio >= 1 THEN 60 WHEN current_ratio >= 0.8 THEN 40 WHEN current_ratio >= 0.5 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS liquidity_score, CASE WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.15 THEN 100 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.1 THEN 80 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.05 THEN 60 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0.02 THEN 40 WHEN net_profit_margin >= 0 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS profitability_score, CASE WHEN receivables_turnover >= 12 THEN 100 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 8 THEN 80 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 6 THEN 60 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 4 THEN 40 WHEN receivables_turnover >= 2 THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS efficiency_score FROM ratios

      description: Liquidity, profitability, and efficiency metrics by subsidiary for the latest balance-sheet period with 12-month income aggregation
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id per accounting_period_id (latest accounting_period_ending only)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__balance_sheet
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__income_statement
      business_logic: '- From the balance sheet, keep only rows where accounting_period_ending equals the global maximum date; aggregate period_balance as the sum of converted_amount by subsidiary_id, account_type_name, accounting_period_id, and accounting_period_ending. - Current assets by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id (from period_balance): - total_current_assets: sum for account types Bank, AcctRec, UnbilledRec, OthCurrAsset (signed as stored). - cash_and_equivalents: sum for account type Bank. - accounts_receivable: sum for account types AcctRec and UnbilledRec. - Current liabilities by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id: - total_current_liabilities: sum of the absolute values of period_balance for account types AcctPay, CredCard, OthCurrLiab (non-negative total). - Equity by subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id: - total_equity: sum for account types Equity, Retained Earnings, Net Income. - From the income statement, keep rows within the last 12 months from today and aggregate by subsidiary_id: - total_revenue: sum where account type is Income. - total_cogs: sum where account type is COGS. - net_income: sum where account type is one of Income, COGS, Expense, OthIncome, OthExpense. - Join logic: current_assets left join current_liabilities and total_equity on subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id; left join income_metrics on subsidiary_id only. - Ratios (no rounding; result is NULL when the denominator is NULL or <= 0): - current_ratio: total_current_assets divided by total_current_liabilities. - quick_ratio: (cash_and_equivalents + accounts_receivable) divided by total_current_liabilities. - cash_ratio: cash_and_equivalents divided by total_current_liabilities. - return_on_equity: net_income divided by total_equity (uses 12-month net income with latest-period equity). - gross_margin_ratio: (total_revenue − total_cogs) divided by total_revenue. - net_profit_margin: net_income divided by total_revenue. - receivables_turnover: total_revenue divided by accounts_receivable (uses period-end AR, not an average). - calculation_date is set to today’s date. - Scores (integers in {0,20,40,60,80,100}; NULL ratios fall to 0 via the default case): - liquidity_score from current_ratio: >=2.0→100, >=1.5→80, >=1.0→60, >=0.8→40, >=0.5→20, else 0. - profitability_score from net_profit_margin: >=0.15→100, >=0.10→80, >=0.05→60, >=0.02→40, >=0→20, else 0. - efficiency_score from receivables_turnover: >=12→100, >=8→80, >=6→60, >=4→40, >=2→20, else 0. - overall_financial_health_score: average of the three scores rounded to two decimals. - financial_health_grade: derived from the rounded overall score (>=80 Excellent, >=60 Good, >=40 Fair, >=20 Poor, else Critical). - financial_ratios_id: MD5 hash of subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id joined with an underscore. - Final filter: drop rows where subsidiary_id is null.'

        tests:

      - name: cash_ratio

        description: Cash and equivalents divided by total current liabilities; NULL if liabilities are NULL or <= 0; no rounding
      - name: return_on_equity
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: gross_margin_ratio

      - name: net_profit_margin

      - name: receivables_turnover
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: total_current_assets
        data_type: DOUBLE

      - name: total_current_liabilities
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute period_balance for account types AcctPay, CredCard, OthCurrLiab in the latest global period (non-negative)
      - name: cash_and_equivalents
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account type Bank in the latest global period
      - name: accounts_receivable
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account types AcctRec and UnbilledRec in the latest global period
      - name: total_equity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of period_balance for account types Equity, Retained Earnings, Net Income in the latest global period
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum where account type is Income over the last 12 months by subsidiary
      - name: total_cogs
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum where account type is COGS over the last 12 months by subsidiary
      - name: net_income
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum where account type is one of Income, COGS, Expense, OthIncome, OthExpense over the last 12 months
      - name: calculation_date

      - name: financial_health_grade

      - name: financial_ratios_id

- name: int_netsuite2__income_statement
      description: Income statement lines with joined dimensions and converted amounts for profitability analysis
      grain: One row per transaction_id + transaction_line_id for income-statement transactions in their reporting period
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts. - Inner join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines on both transaction_id and transaction_line_id to bring line-level attributes. - Left join dimensions: - Accounts by account_id. - Accounting periods (as reporting_accounting_periods) by reporting_accounting_period_id. - Subsidiaries by subsidiary_id, then currencies by subsidiaries.currency_id to get the subsidiary currency symbol. - Classes by class_id, locations by location_id, and departments by department_id from the transaction line. - Keep only rows where is_income_statement is true and the transaction accounting period equals the reporting accounting period. - Select identifiers and attributes from the joined tables, including reporting period, account, subsidiary, class, location, department, and account_category. - Derivations: - account_number_and_name: join account_number and account_name with a single "-" (no spaces); if either input is NULL, the result is NULL. - income_statement_sort_helper: map the lowercase account_type_name as income→1, cogs→2, expense→3, othincome→4, othexpense→5; otherwise NULL. - converted_amount: negate converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period; transaction_amount: negate unconverted_amount; NULLs propagate. - Surrogate key income_statement_id: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, and account_name joined by underscores; if any component is NULL, the key is NULL. - No aggregation or de-duplication is performed; duplicates from sources are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: income_statement_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of transaction_line_id, transaction_id, accounting_period_id, and account_name joined with '_' (NULL in any component yields NULL)
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction line identifier aligned via int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting accounting period identifier from int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reporting accounting period end date
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporting accounting period name
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the reporting accounting period is an adjustment period
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the reporting accounting period is closed
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type name from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from the accounts dimension
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the subsidiary associated with the transaction
      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary full name from staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary short name from staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - name: subsidiary_currency_symbol
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency symbol of the transaction’s subsidiary from staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - name: account_number_and_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: account_number and account_name joined by '-' with no spaces; NULL if either part is NULL
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class identifier from the transaction line
      - name: class_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full class name from staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      - name: location_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location identifier from the transaction line
      - name: location_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full location name from staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from the transaction line
      - name: department_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full department name from staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - name: account_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account category copied from int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - name: income_statement_sort_helper
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Sort rank from account_type_name (lowercased): income=1, cogs=2, expense=3, othincome=4, othexpense=5; else NULL'
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Negated converted_amount_using_transaction_accounting_period (NULL if source is NULL)
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Negated unconverted_amount (NULL if source is NULL)

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_netsuite2__supplier_credit_monitoring
      description: Supplier credit monitoring and risk assessment per vendor-subsidiary derived from Netsuite transaction details and lines
      grain: One row per (vendor_id, subsidiary_id) where vendor_id is not null and total_expenses > 0
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: '1) Build vendor_transactions by joining transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Payable, AcctPay, Expense, OthExpense, Bank. - Derive vendor fields deterministically from entity_id: vendor_id = entity_id; vendor_name = "Vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email = "vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id + "@supplier.com"; vendor_creation_date is 730 days before the run date; vendor_relationship_days = 730. - Classify transaction_category: Payable for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; Expense for Expense or OthExpense; Payment for Bank; otherwise Other. - Set payment_status: Paid for Bank; Outstanding for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; otherwise Other. 2) Aggregate vendor_payment_behavior grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_creation_date, vendor_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_payables: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payable; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_payments: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payment; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Expense; NULL amounts do not contribute. - outstanding_balance: sum of absolute converted_amount for rows with payment_status Outstanding; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id across all grouped rows. - payment_transactions: count of rows classified as Payment where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows with payment_status Outstanding where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows with payment_status Outstanding. - last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows classified as Payment. 3) Compute vendor_risk_metrics: - payment_ratio: total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables is positive; otherwise 0. - avg_payment_delay_days: if there is at least one payment transaction, set to 15 plus a deterministic offset from 0 to 29 based on vendor_id, yielding 15–44; otherwise NULL. - relationship_duration_months: number of calendar months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; otherwise 1. - vendor_activity_status: Active if the last transaction is within 30 days of the run date; Recent if within 90; Dormant if within 180; otherwise Inactive; if last_transaction_date is NULL, treat as Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; if it does not exist, set to 0. 4) Compute vendor_credit_scoring: - payment_performance_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else. - payment_timeliness_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL delay yields 1. - relationship_stability_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else. - transaction_frequency_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else. 5) Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the four component scores. - credit_rating: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_balance exceeds 30% of total_expenses and days_since_last_outstanding >60; Medium Risk if exceeds 20% and >45; Low Risk if outstanding_balance >0 and >30; otherwise Minimal Risk (evaluated in this order). - recommended_credit_limit: total_expenses multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - monitoring_date: the run date. - supplier_monitoring_id: MD5 hash of vendor_id and subsidiary_id joined by an underscore. - Filter final rows to vendor_id present and total_expenses > 0.'
      columns:
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier from transaction_lines.entity_id; not null; grouping key with subsidiary_id
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic name 'Vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id; deterministic per vendor_id
      - name: vendor_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Synthetic email 'vendor_' + first 8 chars of vendor_id + '@supplier.com'; deterministic per vendor_id
      - name: vendor_creation_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp 730 days before the run date; constant per run
      - name: vendor_relationship_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 730 representing relationship age in days
      - name: relationship_duration_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; else 1
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from transaction details; groups output with vendor_id
      - name: total_payables
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payable transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_payments
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Payment transactions; NULL amounts excluded; no rounding
      - name: total_expenses
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount for Expense transactions; NULL amounts excluded; filtered to > 0
      - name: outstanding_balance
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of absolute converted_amount where payment_status is Outstanding; NULL amounts excluded
      - name: payment_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables > 0; else 0
      - name: avg_payment_delay_days
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: If payment_transactions > 0 then deterministic integer in 15–44 based on vendor_id; else NULL
      - name: total_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of distinct transaction_id across joined rows
      - name: payment_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows classified as Payment with non-NULL transaction_id; not distinct
      - name: outstanding_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of rows with payment_status Outstanding and non-NULL transaction_id; not distinct
      - name: first_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest accounting_period_ending per group
      - name: last_transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending per group
      - name: last_payment_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Payment transactions; NULL if none
      - name: last_outstanding_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest accounting_period_ending among Outstanding transactions; NULL if none
      - name: days_since_last_outstanding
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; 0 if no Outstanding exists
      - name: payment_performance_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio thresholds ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else
      - name: payment_timeliness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days thresholds ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL yields 1
      - name: relationship_stability_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months thresholds ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else
      - name: transaction_frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Score 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions thresholds ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else
      - name: total_credit_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of payment_performance_score, payment_timeliness_score, relationship_stability_score, and transaction_frequency_score
      - name: credit_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB based on total_credit_score thresholds ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR

specification.name: int_netsuite2__supplier_credit_monitoring
specification.description: Supplier credit monitoring and risk assessment per vendor-subsidiary derived from Netsuite transaction details and lines
specification.grain: One row per (vendor_id, subsidiary_id) where vendor_id is not null and total_expenses > 0
specification.business_logic: 1) Build vendor_transactions by joining transaction details to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; keep rows where entity_id is present and account_type_name is one of Accounts Payable, AcctPay, Expense, OthExpense, Bank. - Derive vendor fields deterministically from entity_id: vendor_id = entity_id; vendor_name = "Vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id; vendor_email = "vendor_" + first 8 characters of vendor_id + "@supplier.com"; vendor_creation_date is 730 days before the run date; vendor_relationship_days = 730. - Classify transaction_category: Payable for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; Expense for Expense or OthExpense; Payment for Bank; otherwise Other. - Set payment_status: Paid for Bank; Outstanding for Accounts Payable or AcctPay; otherwise Other. 2) Aggregate vendor_payment_behavior grouped by vendor_id, vendor_name, vendor_email, vendor_creation_date, vendor_relationship_days, subsidiary_id: - total_payables: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payable; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_payments: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Payment; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount for transactions classified as Expense; NULL amounts do not contribute. - outstanding_balance: sum of absolute converted_amount for rows with payment_status Outstanding; NULL amounts do not contribute. - total_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id across all grouped rows. - payment_transactions: count of rows classified as Payment where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - outstanding_transactions: count of rows with payment_status Outstanding where transaction_id is present; not distinct. - first_transaction_date: earliest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_transaction_date: latest accounting_period_ending in the group. - last_outstanding_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows with payment_status Outstanding. - last_payment_date: latest accounting_period_ending among rows classified as Payment. 3) Compute vendor_risk_metrics: - payment_ratio: total_payments divided by total_payables when total_payables is positive; otherwise 0. - avg_payment_delay_days: if there is at least one payment transaction, set to 15 plus a deterministic offset from 0 to 29 based on vendor_id, yielding 15–44; otherwise NULL. - relationship_duration_months: number of calendar months between first and last transaction plus 1 when both exist; otherwise 1. - vendor_activity_status: Active if the last transaction is within 30 days of the run date; Recent if within 90; Dormant if within 180; otherwise Inactive; if last_transaction_date is NULL, treat as Inactive. - days_since_last_outstanding: days elapsed since last_outstanding_date; if it does not exist, set to 0. 4) Compute vendor_credit_scoring: - payment_performance_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for payment_ratio ≥0.95/≥0.85/≥0.75/≥0.60/else. - payment_timeliness_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for avg_payment_delay_days ≤20/≤30/≤40/≤50/else; NULL delay yields 1. - relationship_stability_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for relationship_duration_months ≥24/≥12/≥6/≥3/else. - transaction_frequency_score: 5/4/3/2/1 for total_transactions ≥50/≥25/≥10/≥5/else. 5) Final outputs: - total_credit_score: sum of the four component scores. - credit_rating: AAA/AA/A/BBB/BB for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - risk_level: High Risk if outstanding_balance exceeds 30% of total_expenses and days_since_last_outstanding >60; Medium Risk if exceeds 20% and >45; Low Risk if outstanding_balance >0 and >30; otherwise Minimal Risk (evaluated in this order). - recommended_credit_limit: total_expenses multiplied by 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 for total_credit_score ≥16/≥13/≥10/≥7/else. - monitoring_date: the run date. - supplier_monitoring_id: MD5 hash of vendor_id and subsidiary_id joined by an underscore. - Filter final rows to vendor_id present and total_expenses > 0.

      description: Mapping of non-quarter, non-year base accounting periods to same-calendar reporting periods that start on/after the base and are not in the future.

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Identifier of a non-quarter, non-year reporting period in the same fiscal calendar that starts on or after the base and is not in the future when evaluated.
