cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 365 THEN 'Long-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 180 THEN 'Medium-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 90 THEN 'Short-term' WHEN customer_lifespan_days >= 30 THEN 'New' ELSE 'Very New' END AS retention_category, CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 30 THEN 'Highly Active' WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 90 THEN 'Active' WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 180 THEN 'At Risk' WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 365 THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Lost' END AS activity_status, total_transactions / NULLIF(customer_lifespan_days / 30.0, 0) AS avg_transactions_per_month, CAST(CASE WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 30 AND total_transactions >= 5 THEN 0.95 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 60 AND total_transactions >= 3 THEN 0.80 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 90 AND total_transactions >= 2 THEN 0.60 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 180 THEN 0.30 WHEN days_since_last_transaction <= 365 THEN 0.10 ELSE 0.05 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2)) AS retention_probability FROM behavior

cte_definitions.name: cp
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue) AS rev_pct FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability

cte_definitions.name: enriched
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT cp.*, r.*, CASE WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.9 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.7 THEN 'Gold' WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.5 THEN 'Silver' WHEN cp.rev_pct >= 0.3 THEN 'Bronze' ELSE 'Basic' END AS value_tier FROM cp LEFT JOIN retention AS r ON r.customer_id = cp.customer_id

cte_definitions.name: scored
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CAST(LEAST(100, revenue_score * 10 + frequency_score * 5 + margin_score * 5 + CASE WHEN activity_status = 'Highly Active' THEN 15 WHEN activity_status = 'Active' THEN 10 ELSE 0 END + retention_probability * 20) AS INT) AS comprehensive_customer_score, CASE WHEN customer_age_days <= 90 AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active', 'Active') THEN 'Onboarding' WHEN customer_age_days <= 365 AND total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM cp) THEN 'Growth' WHEN retention_category IN ('Long-term', 'Medium-term') AND activity_status IN ('Highly Active', 'Active') THEN 'Mature' WHEN activity_status = 'At Risk' THEN 'At Risk' WHEN activity_status IN ('Dormant', 'Lost') THEN 'Churned' ELSE 'Developing' END AS lifecycle_stage FROM enriched

cte_definitions.name: insights
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN q1_transactions >= GREATEST(q2_transactions, q3_transactions, q4_transactions) THEN 'Q1 Peak' WHEN q2_transactions >= GREATEST(q1_transactions, q3_transactions, q4_transactions) THEN 'Q2 Peak' WHEN q3_transactions >= GREATEST(q1_transactions, q2_transactions, q4_transactions) THEN 'Q3 Peak' WHEN q4_transactions >= GREATEST(q1_transactions, q2_transactions, q3_transactions) THEN 'Q4 Peak' ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END AS seasonal_preference, CASE WHEN transaction_value_volatility IS NULL OR transaction_value_volatility = 0 THEN 'Single Transaction' WHEN transaction_value_volatility <= 0.3 * avg_transaction_value THEN 'Very Consistent' WHEN transaction_value_volatility <= 0.6 * avg_transaction_value THEN 'Consistent' WHEN transaction_value_volatility <= avg_transaction_value THEN 'Moderate Variance' ELSE 'High Variance' END AS transaction_consistency, CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Onboarding' AND comprehensive_customer_score >= 70 THEN 'High Growth Potential' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' AND value_tier IN ('Gold', 'Platinum') THEN 'Expansion Ready' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Mature' AND activity_status = 'Highly Active' THEN 'Loyalty Program Candidate' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'At Risk' AND value_tier IN ('Silver', 'Gold', 'Platinum') THEN 'Recovery Priority' ELSE 'Standard Growth' END AS growth_potential FROM scored

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics derived from profitability (RFM-style), behavior patterns, retention scoring, and action recommendations
      grain: One row per customer_id (per build date = segmentation_date)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      business_logic: 'Build a customer analytics view by combining profitability (cp), behavioral patterns (cbp), and retention (cr), then deriving insights and recommendations: - customer_behavior_patterns (cbp): - Join intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t to staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines tl on transaction_line_id. - Filter rows: tl.entity_id IS NOT NULL, t.account_type_name = ''Income'', t.converted_amount > 0. - Aggregate by tl.entity_id (as customer_id) and t.subsidiary_id: - Transaction frequency: total_transactions = distinct transaction_id count; active_months = distinct calendar months; active_quarters = distinct calendar quarters. - Amounts (Income only): total_revenue = sum of positive amounts; avg_transaction_value = mean of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); transaction_value_volatility = sample standard deviation of positive amounts (NULLs excluded); max/min as per positive Income amounts. - Timing: first_transaction_date = earliest accounting period end; last_transaction_date = latest accounting period end; customer_lifespan_days = days between first and last transaction. - Seasonal counts: q1/q2/q3/q4_transactions = distinct transaction counts by calendar quarter. - Recency: days_since_last_transaction = days between last transaction and today. - analysis_date = today. - customer_retention (cr) from cbp: - retention_category by customer_lifespan_days thresholds: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New. - activity_status by days_since_last_transaction: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost. - avg_transactions_per_month = total_transactions divided by (customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months > 0 and customer_lifespan_days > 0; otherwise 0; no rounding. - retention_probability: 0.95 if days≤30 and total_transactions≥5; 0.80 if days≤60 and total_transactions≥3; 0.60 if days≤90 and total_transactions≥2; 0.30 if days≤180; 0.10 if days≤365; else 0.05. - Carry through total_transactions, total_revenue, avg_transaction_value, days_since_last_transaction. - enhanced_customer_segmentation (ecs) by left joining cp to cr on customer_id: - Carry cp.customer_name, customer_email, subsidiary_id, profitability_segment (cp.customer_segment), total_revenue, net_profit, transaction_count, customer_age_days; avg_transactions_per_month and retention_probability from cr. - value_tier via overall revenue percentile thresholds across cp: ≥90th Platinum; ≥70th Gold; ≥50th Silver; ≥30th Bronze; else Basic (inclusive comparisons). - comprehensive_customer_score = weighted sum of cp revenue/frequency/margin scores plus activity and retention bonuses, capped at 100. - lifecycle_stage: Onboarding if customer_age_days≤90 and activity in (Highly Active, Active); Growth if customer_age_days≤365 and revenue above the overall cp average; Mature if retention in (Long-term, Medium-term) and activity in (Highly Active, Active); At Risk if activity = At Risk; Churned if activity in (Dormant, Lost); else Developing. - segmentation_date = today. - customer_insights by left joining ecs to cbp on customer_id: - Carry transaction_value_volatility and q1–q4_transactions from cbp. - seasonal_preference from the highest of q1..q4 counts: Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 Peak based on which count is the maximum; ties break by first match in order Q1→Q2→Q3→Q4; else No Clear Pattern. - transaction_consistency: if volatility is NULL or 0 then Single Transaction; else compare volatility to avg_transaction_value: ≤0.3x Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance. - growth_potential: High Growth Potential if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding and comprehensive_customer_score≥70; Expansion Ready if lifecycle_stage=Growth and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum); Loyalty Program Candidate if lifecycle_stage=Mature and activity_status=Highly Active; Recovery Priority if lifecycle_stage=At Risk and value_tier in (Silver, Gold, Platinum); else Standard Growth. - recommended_action (evaluated in order): if lifecycle_stage=Churned and value_tier in (Gold, Platinum) then Win-Back Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Retention Campaign; else if lifecycle_stage=Onboarding then Onboarding Support; else if growth_potential=Expansion Ready then Upsell Opportunity; else if value_tier=Platinum and activity_status=Highly Active then VIP Treatment; else Regular Engagement. - engagement_frequency (first-match wins): Platinum Weekly; else Gold Bi-weekly; else Silver Monthly; else if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly. - Final projection and filters: - Select the columns listed below from customer_insights. - Filter out rows where customer_id IS NULL and where cp.total_revenue ≤ 0. - Create customer_analytics_id as a deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore. - Sort descending by comprehensive_customer_score, then by total_revenue. - Result grain is one row per customer_id for the build date (segmentation_date).'
      columns:
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier sourced from cp (and cbp), filtered to NOT NULL in final output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: customer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer name from cp; propagated as-is without trimming or case normalization
      - name: customer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email from cp; propagated as-is without validation
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from cp (behavioral CTE uses t.subsidiary_id but final value comes from cp)
      - name: profitability_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Profitability classification from cp.customer_segment carried through unchanged
      - name: value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Revenue-based tier using overall percentile thresholds on cp.total_revenue: ≥P90 Platinum, ≥P70 Gold, ≥P50 Silver, ≥P30 Bronze, else Basic'
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage derived from customer_age_days, activity_status, retention_category, and cp.total_revenue vs cp average per defined precedence
      - name: activity_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recency-based activity: ≤30 Highly Active; ≤90 Active; ≤180 At Risk; ≤365 Dormant; else Lost based on days_since_last_transaction'
      - name: retention_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tenure-based retention: ≥365 Long-term; ≥180 Medium-term; ≥90 Short-term; ≥30 New; else Very New based on customer_lifespan_days'
      - name: total_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total revenue from cp; final rows require total_revenue > 0; units as defined in cp (no conversion here)
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net profit from cp; no additional adjustments applied
      - name: transaction_count
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total transaction count from cp; may differ from cbp total_transactions; no distinct logic applied here
      - name: avg_transactions_per_month
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average transactions per 30-day month from cbp: total_transactions/(customer_lifespan_days/30.0) when active_months>0 and lifespan>0 else 0 (no rounding)'
      - name: comprehensive_customer_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Composite score capped at 100 from weighted cp scores plus activity and retention bonuses per defined mapping
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Predicted retention probability from discrete thresholds: 0.95/0.80/0.60/0.30/0.10/0.05 per recency and total_transactions'
      - name: seasonal_preference
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Quarter with highest distinct transaction count: ''Qx Peak'' with tie-breaker order Q1>Q2>Q3>Q4; else ''No Clear Pattern'''
      - name: transaction_consistency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Volatility classification: NULL or 0→Single Transaction; ≤0.3x avg Very Consistent; ≤0.6x Consistent; ≤1.0x Moderate Variance; else High Variance'
      - name: growth_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Growth outlook from lifecycle_stage, value_tier, activity_status, and score: High Growth Potential, Expansion Ready, Loyalty Program Candidate, Recovery Priority, or Standard Growth'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation precedence: Win-Back Campaign, Retention Campaign, Onboarding Support, Upsell Opportunity, VIP Treatment, else Regular Engagement'
      - name: engagement_frequency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Suggested touch cadence: Platinum Weekly; Gold Bi-weekly; Silver Monthly; if lifecycle_stage=At Risk then Immediate; else Quarterly'
      - name: customer_age_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Days since customer creation from cp; integer day count
      - name: segmentation_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Build date set to current_date for all rows in the run
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: transaction_value_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sample standard deviation of positive Income converted_amounts per customer from cbp; NULL if insufficient data
      - name: q1_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q1 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q2_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q2 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q3_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q3 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: q4_transactions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct Income transaction_id count in calendar Q4 from cbp; non-negative integer
      - name: customer_analytics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic hash of customer_id and segmentation_date joined by an underscore
        tests:
        - not_null

agent_sql.raw_text: WITH cf AS (SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis WHERE analysis_month=date_trunc('month',current_date-interval '1 month')), ar AS (SELECT subsidiary_id,sum(total_ar_amount) total_ar_amount,sum(overdue_amount) overdue_amount,sum(overdue_amount)/nullif(sum(total_ar_amount),0) overdue_percentage,avg(weighted_average_days_outstanding) weighted_average_days_outstanding FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__ar_aging_analysis GROUP BY subsidiary_id), cp AS (SELECT subsidiary_id,count(*) total_customers,count(*) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment IN ('Champion','Loyal')) high_value_customers,count(*) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment='At Risk' OR activity_status='At Risk') at_risk_customers,sum(total_revenue) total_customer_revenue,avg(total_revenue) average_customer_value FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability GROUP BY subsidiary_id), base AS (SELECT fr.*,current_date dashboard_date,cf.net_cash_flow,cf.operating_cash_flow,cf.cash_flow_health,cf.predicted_next_month_cash_flow,cf.cash_flow_risk_level,ar.total_ar_amount,ar.overdue_amount,ar.overdue_percentage,ar.weighted_average_days_outstanding,cp.total_customers,cp.high_value_customers,cp.at_risk_customers,cp.total_customer_revenue,cp.average_customer_value FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios fr LEFT JOIN cf USING(subsidiary_id) LEFT JOIN ar USING(subsidiary_id) LEFT JOIN cp USING(subsidiary_id)), trends AS (SELECT *,overall_financial_health_score avg_financial_health,overall_financial_health_score*0 financial_health_volatility,net_profit_margin avg_net_margin,current_ratio avg_current_ratio,CASE WHEN cash_flow_health IN ('Excellent','Good') THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END cash_flow_consistency_percentage FROM base), risk AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN overall_financial_health_score<40 THEN 30 WHEN overall_financial_health_score<60 THEN 20 WHEN overall_financial_health_score<80 THEN 10 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN cash_flow_risk_level='High Risk - Negative Trend' THEN 25 WHEN cash_flow_risk_level LIKE '%High Risk%' THEN 20 WHEN cash_flow_risk_level LIKE '%Medium Risk%' THEN 10 ELSE 5 END + CASE WHEN overdue_percentage>.30 THEN 20 WHEN overdue_percentage>.20 THEN 15 WHEN overdue_percentage>.10 THEN blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_financial_dashboard
      description: Executive financial dashboard aggregating ratios, cash flow, AR, customer metrics, trends, risk and benchmarks per subsidiary-period
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id present in intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__cash_flow_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__ar_aging_analysis
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customer_profitability
      business_logic: '- Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; casing and spacing are preserved. - Result ordering: descending by total_risk_score, then descending by overall_financial_health_score.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier; rows with NULL are excluded
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period from financial_ratios for the row
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: dashboard_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Build date set to current_date at query execution (same for all rows in a run)
      - name: current_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Liquidity ratio from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: quick_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Quick ratio from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: return_on_equity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: ROE from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: gross_margin_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross margin ratio from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: net_profit_margin
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net profit margin from financial_ratios; no rounding; NULL if missing in source
      - name: overall_financial_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite financial health score from financial_ratios; NULL if missing in source
      - name: financial_health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Letter grade from financial_ratios corresponding to the health score; NULL if missing
      - name: net_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net cash flow for prior calendar month per subsidiary; NULL if no CF row for that month
      - name: operating_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Operating cash flow for prior calendar month per subsidiary; NULL if no CF row for that month
      - name: cash_flow_health
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cash flow health label from CF for prior month; NULL if no CF row
      - name: predicted_next_month_cash_flow
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Predicted next month cash flow from CF; NULL if no prior-month CF row
      - name: cash_flow_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Cash flow risk level from CF; used in risk scoring; NULL if no prior-month CF row
      - name: total_ar_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total AR amount summed across AR aging rows per subsidiary; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: overdue_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total overdue AR amount summed across AR aging rows per subsidiary; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: overdue_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Ratio of overdue amount to total AR when total AR>0; otherwise 0; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: weighted_average_days_outstanding
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Simple average of weighted_average_days_outstanding across AR rows; NULLs ignored; NULL if no AR rows
      - name: total_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of customer_profitability rows per subsidiary; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: high_value_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count where customer_segment in ('Champion','Loyal'); duplicates preserved; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: at_risk_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count where customer_segment='At Risk' or activity_status='At Risk'; duplicates preserved; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: total_customer_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of total_revenue across customer rows per subsidiary; NULL if no customer rows
      - name: average_customer_value

specification.name: netsuite2_financial_dashboard
specification.description: Executive financial dashboard aggregating ratios, cash flow, AR, customer metrics, trends, risk and benchmarks per subsidiary-period
specification.grain: One row per subsidiary_id and accounting_period_id present in intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios
specification.business_logic: - Base rows come from intermediate.int_netsuite2__financial_ratios (fr); dashboard_date is set to the current_date at execution for all rows. - Left join cash_flow_analysis (cf) by subsidiary_id, filtering to the previous calendar month (the month of current_date minus one month); bring net_cash_flow, operating_cash_flow, cash_flow_health, predicted_next_month_cash_flow, cash_flow_risk_level. If no prior-month CF row exists for the subsidiary, CF outputs are NULL. - Left join AR aging (ar) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all ar rows per subsidiary: - total_ar_amount and overdue_amount are summed across rows (ignoring NULLs). - overdue_percentage is the ratio of total overdue amount to total AR amount when total AR > 0; otherwise 0. If no AR rows exist for the subsidiary, all AR outputs are NULL. - weighted_average_days_outstanding is the simple average across rows (ignoring NULLs). - Left join customer profitability (cp_summary) by subsidiary_id, aggregating across all cp rows per subsidiary: - total_customers is the row count. - high_value_customers counts rows where customer_segment is Champion or Loyal. - at_risk_customers counts rows where customer_segment is At Risk or activity_status is At Risk. - total_customer_revenue is the sum of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs); average_customer_value is the average of total_revenue (ignoring NULLs). - No de-duplication; if no cp rows for the subsidiary, cp outputs are NULL. - Compute trends (ft) by aggregating financial_kpis per subsidiary_id: - avg_financial_health is the average of overall_financial_health_score; financial_health_volatility is its standard deviation. - avg_net_margin is the average of net_profit_margin; avg_current_ratio is the average of current_ratio. - positive_cash_flow_periods counts rows with cash_flow_health in Excellent or Good; total_periods counts all rows. - Compute risk assessment (ra) per subsidiary_id: - total_risk_score is the sum of four components: - overall_financial_health_score: <40 → 30; <60 → 20; <80 → 10; else 5. - cash_flow_risk_level: High Risk - Negative Trend → 25; contains High Risk → 20; contains Medium Risk → 10; else 5. - overdue_percentage: >0.30 → 20; >0.20 → 15; >0.10 → 10; else 5. - current_ratio: <1.0 → 25; <1.5 → 15; <2.0 → 10; else 5. - When any compared input is NULL, the corresponding component contributes 5. - risk_level buckets: total_risk_score ≥70 → Critical Risk; ≥50 → High Risk; ≥30 → Medium Risk; else Low Risk. - primary_risk_factor priority: overall_financial_health_score<40 → Poor Financial Health; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → Cash Flow Issues; overdue_percentage>0.30 → High Receivables Risk; current_ratio<1.0 → Liquidity Concerns; else No Major Risk Factors. - Compute performance benchmarks (pb) per subsidiary_id: - liquidity_performance from current_ratio: ≥2.0 → Above Target; ≥1.5 → At Target; else Below Target. - profitability_performance from net_profit_margin: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.05 → At Target; else Below Target. - roe_performance from return_on_equity: ≥0.15 → Above Target; ≥0.10 → At Target; else Below Target. - collection_performance from overdue_percentage: ≤0.05 → Above Target; ≤0.15 → At Target; else Below Target. - improvement_recommendation priority: - If current_ratio<1.5 and net_profit_margin<0.05 → Focus on Operations & Liquidity; - Else if current_ratio<1.5 → Improve Working Capital Management; - Else if net_profit_margin<0.05 → Review Cost Structure; - Else if overdue_percentage>0.15 → Strengthen Collections; - Else → Maintain Current Performance. - Final output: - Select fk.* plus ft, ra, pb by subsidiary_id; filter out rows with NULL subsidiary_id. - cash_flow_consistency_percentage = (positive_cash_flow_periods / total_periods) × 100, rounded to 1 decimal; if total_periods=0, set to 0. - overall_rating, in order: overall_financial_health_score≥80 and risk_level=Low Risk → A+ Excellent; ≥70 and risk_level in Low/Medium Risk → A Good; ≥60 and risk_level≠Critical Risk → B Fair; ≥40 → C Poor; else → D Critical. - key_alert, first match wins: risk_level=Critical Risk → URGENT: Multiple Critical Risk Factors; cash_flow_risk_level contains High Risk → WARNING: Cash Flow Issues; current_ratio<1.0 → ALERT: Liquidity Below Safe Levels; overdue_percentage>0.30 → CAUTION: High Receivables Risk; else → Normal Operations. - dashboard_id is the MD5 hash of the string formed by subsidiary_id, a single underscore, and dashboard_date; casing and spacing are preserved. - Result ordering: descending by total_risk_score, then descending by overall_financial_health_score.

agent_sql.raw_text: WITH grouped AS (SELECT t.subsidiary_id,l.department_id,d.name department_name,l.location_id,loc.name location_name,l.class_id,date_trunc('month',t.accounting_period_ending)::DATE performance_month,sum(t.converted_amount) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name='Income') department_revenue, sum(abs(t.converted_amount)) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name='COGS') department_cogs,sum(abs(t.converted_amount)) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name='Expense') department_expenses,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) transaction_count,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name='Income') revenue_transactions,count(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name IN ('COGS','Expense')) expense_transactions,count(DISTINCT l.entity_id) unique_entities_involved FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details t JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines l USING(transaction_line_id) LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__departments d ON d.department_id=l.department_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_netsuite2__locations loc ON loc.location_id=l.location_id WHERE t.accounting_period_ending>=current_date-interval '24 months' GROUP BY ALL), calc AS (SELECT *,coalesce(department_revenue,0)-coalesce(department_cogs,0) gross_profit,coalesce(department_revenue,0)-coalesce(department_cogs,0)-coalesce(department_expenses,0) net_profit,(coalesce(department_revenue,0)-coalesce(department_cogs,0))/nullif(department_revenue,0) gross_margin_percentage,(coalesce(department_revenue,0)-coalesce(department_cogs,0)-coalesce(department_expenses,0))/nullif(department_revenue,0) net_margin_percentage,department_revenue/nullif(department_expenses,0) revenue_to_expense_ratio,lag(department_revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,department_id ORDER BY performance_month) prev_month_revenue,lag(department_revenue,12) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,department_id ORDER BY performance_month) prior_year_revenue,avg(department_revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,department_id ORDER BY performance_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) three_month_avg_revenue,avg((coalesce(department_revenue,0)-coalesce(department_cogs,0))/nullif(department_revenue,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,department_id ORDER BY performance_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) three_month_avg_margin FROM grouped), calculated AS (SELECT *,round((department_revenue-prev_month_revenue)/nullif(prev_month_revenue,0)*100,2) month_over_month_growth,round((department_revenue-prior_year_revenue)/nullif(prior_year_revenue,0)*100,2) year_over_year_growth,CASE WHEN net_margin_percentage>=.2 AND revenue_to_expense_ratio>=2 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN net_margin_percentage>=.1 AND revenue_to_expense_ratio>=1.5 THEN 'Good' WHEN net_margin_percentage>=.05 AND revenue_to_expense_ratio>=1.2 THEN 'Fair' WHEN net_margin_percentage>0 THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Loss Making' END performance_grade FROM calc), bench AS (SELECT *,rank() OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,performance_month ORDER BY department_revenue DESC) revenue_rank_within_company,rank() OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,performance_month ORDER BY net_margin_percentage DESC) margin_rank_within_company,department_revenue/nullif(avg(department_revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,performance_month),0) revenue_vs_company_avg,net_margin_percentage-avg(net_margin_percentage) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,performance_month) margin_vs_company_avg,department_revenue/nullif(sum(department_revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY subsidiary_id,performance_month),0) internal_market_share,CASE WHEN department_revenue>1.1*three_month_avg_revenue THEN 'Accelerating' WHEN department_revenue>.9*three_month_avg_revenue THEN 'Stable' WHEN department_revenue>.8*three_month_avg_revenue THEN 'Declining' ELSE 'Sharp Decline' END revenue_trend,CASE WHEN gross_margin_percentage>1.05*three_month_avg_margin THEN 'Improving' WHEN gross_margin_percentage>.95*three_month_avg_margin THEN 'Stable' ELSE 'Declining' END margin_trend FROM calculated) SELECT subsidiary_id,department_id,department_name,location_id,location_name,performance_month,department_revenue,gross_profit,net_profit,gross_margin_percentage,net_margin_percentage,revenue_to_expense_ratio,month_over_month_growth,year_over_year_growth,three_month_avg_revenue,revenue_trend,margin_trend,performance_grade,revenue_rank_within_company,margin_rank_within_company,revenue_vs_company_avg,margin_vs_company_avg,internal_market_share,CASE WHEN year_over_year_growth < -20 THEN 'Revenue Decline Alert' WHEN net_margin_percentage<0 AND month_over_month_growth < -10 THEN 'Loss Alert' WHEN revenue_to_expense_ratio<1 THEN 'Efficiency Alert' WHEN gross_margin_percentage<.1 THEN 'Margin Alert' ELSE 'Normal' END alert_status,CASE WHEN performance_grade='Loss Making' THEN 'Urgent restructuring required' WHEN performance_grade='Poor' AND revenue_trend='Declining' THEN 'Review operations and cost structure' WHEN margin_trend='Declining' AND revenue_trend='Stable' THEN 'Focus on cost optimization' WHEN revenue_trend='Declining' AND margin_trend='Stable' THEN 'Increase sales and marketing efforts' WHEN performance_grade IN ('Good','Excellent') THEN 'Scale successful practices' ELSE 'Monitor performance closely' END improvement_recommendation,CASE WHEN performance_grade='Excellent' AND revenue_trend='Accelerating' THEN 'Increase Investment' WHEN performance_grade IN ('Good','Excellent') AND internal_market_share<.3 THEN 'Growth Investment' WHEN performance_grade='Fair' AND margin_trend='Improving' THEN 'Selective Investment' WHEN performance_grade IN ('Poor','Loss Making') THEN 'Review Investment' ELSE 'Maintain Current Investment' END investment_recommendation,current_date analysis_date,CASE WHEN subsidiary_id IS NULL OR department_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE md5(subsidiary_id||'_'||department_id||'_'||cast(performance_month AS VARCHAR)) END operational_metrics_id FROM bench WHERE performance_month>=date_trunc('month',current_date-interval '12 months') AND department_revenue IS NOT NULL

t.accounting_period_ending) AS DATE) AS performance_month, SUM(t.converted_amount) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name = 'Income') AS department_revenue, SUM(ABS(t.converted_amount)) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name = 'COGS') AS department_cogs, SUM(ABS(t.converted_amount)) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name = 'Expense') AS department_expenses, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) AS transaction_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name = 'Income') AS revenue_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transaction_id) FILTER(WHERE t.account_type_name IN ('COGS', 'Expense')) AS expense_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT l.entity_id) AS unique_entities_involved FROM intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details AS t JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines AS l USING (transaction_line_id) LEFT JOIN staging.stg_netsuite2__departments AS d ON d.department_id = l.department_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_netsuite2__locations AS loc ON loc.location_id = l.location_id WHERE t.accounting_period_ending >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '24' MONTHS GROUP BY ALL), calc AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(department_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(department_cogs, 0) AS gross_profit, blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_operational_metrics
      description: Department/location monthly operational KPIs with trends, benchmarking, alerts, and recommendations derived from Netsuite transactions
      grain: One row per subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, performance_month; if multiple class_id exist for the same keys, rows are duplicated (class_id is part of the internal grouping but not exposed)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_details
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: '- Filter transactions to the last 24 months by accounting_period_ending. - Join transactions to transaction lines on transaction_line_id; left join departments, locations, and classes for display names. - Group by subsidiary_id, department_id, location_id, class_id, the month start of accounting_period_ending (performance_month), and the quarter; compute: - department_revenue: sum of converted_amount where account type is Income; 0 if none. - department_cogs: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is COGS; non-negative. - department_expenses: sum of absolute converted_amount where account type is Expense; non-negative. - transaction_count: count of distinct transaction_id. - revenue_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is Income. - expense_transactions: count of distinct transaction_id where account type is COGS or Expense. - unique_entities_involved: count of distinct tl.entity_id. - analysis_date: current_date. - Derive operational efficiency per grouped row: - revenue_to_expense_ratio: revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0; otherwise NULL. - gross_profit: revenue minus cogs. - gross_margin_percentage: (revenue minus cogs) divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - net_profit: revenue minus cogs minus expenses. - net_margin_percentage: net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0; otherwise 0. - Additional intermediates (not selected later): average revenue per revenue transaction, average expense per expense transaction, and revenue per unique entity. - Compute trends per (subsidiary_id, department_id) using rows ordered by performance_month: - prev_month_revenue: value from the previous row in this order. - same_month_last_year_revenue: value from 12 rows prior in this order. - three_month_avg_revenue: average of the current row and the two immediately preceding rows (uses available rows when fewer than three). - three_month_avg_margin: same three-row window for gross_margin_percentage. - Note: because multiple location/class rows can exist for the same month, these windows operate over rows, not unique months; ties within a month use the engine’s row order. - Compute performance analysis: - month_over_month_growth: percentage change versus prev_month_revenue; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when prev_month_revenue <= 0 or missing. - year_over_year_growth: percentage change versus the revenue 12 rows prior; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing. - revenue_trend: ''Accelerating'' if revenue > 110% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 90%; ''Declining'' if > 80%; else ''Sharp Decline''. - margin_trend: ''Improving'' if margin > 105% of the three-row average; ''Stable'' if > 95%; else ''Declining''. - performance_grade: ''Excellent'' when net margin >= 0.2 and ratio >= 2.0; ''Good'' when >= 0.1 and >= 1.5; ''Fair'' when >= 0.05 and >= 1.2; ''Poor'' when > 0; else ''Loss Making''. - Benchmark within each (subsidiary_id, performance_month): - revenue_rank_within_company: ranking by department_revenue descending; ties share rank with gaps. - margin_rank_within_company: ranking by net_margin_percentage descending; ties share rank with gaps. - revenue_vs_company_avg: revenue divided by the partition average revenue. - margin_vs_company_avg: net_margin_percentage minus the partition average net margin. - internal_market_share: revenue divided by the partition total revenue. - Alerts and recommendations (first matching condition applies): - alert_status: ''Revenue Decline Alert'' when year_over_year_growth < -20; else ''Loss Alert'' when net_margin_percentage < 0 and month_over_month_growth < -10; else ''Efficiency Alert'' when revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1.0; else ''Margin Alert'' when gross_margin_percentage < 0.1; else ''Normal''. NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts. - improvement_recommendation: ''Urgent restructuring required'' for ''Loss Making''; ''Review operations and cost structure'' for ''Poor'' with revenue_trend=''Declining''; ''Focus on cost optimization'' for margin_trend=''Declining'' with revenue_trend=''Stable''; ''Increase sales and marketing efforts'' for revenue_trend=''Declining'' with margin_trend=''Stable''; ''Scale successful practices'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent''; else ''Monitor performance closely''. - investment_recommendation: ''Increase Investment'' for ''Excellent'' with ''Accelerating'' revenue; ''Growth Investment'' for ''Good'' or ''Excellent'' when internal_market_share < 0.3; ''Selective Investment'' for ''Fair'' with ''Improving'' margin; ''Review Investment'' for ''Poor'' or ''Loss Making''; else ''Maintain Current Investment''. - Final filter: keep only rows with performance_month in the last 12 months and non-NULL department_revenue. - Output order does not affect values: sort by subsidiary_id, performance_month descending, then department_revenue descending. - operational_metrics_id is an MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated; any NULL input yields NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Subsidiary identifier sourced from transactions; grouping key used for window partitions and benchmarking
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from transaction lines; may be NULL; used for grouping and window partitions
      - name: department_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department display name from the departments table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: location_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location identifier from transaction lines; included in grouping; may be NULL
      - name: location_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location display name from the locations table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved
      - name: performance_month
        data_type: DATE
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Month start date from accounting_period_ending; only the last 12 months are kept in the final result
      - name: department_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of converted_amount for Income lines per group; sign preserved; 0 when no Income lines exist
      - name: gross_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS where COGS is the sum of absolute amounts for COGS lines
      - name: net_profit
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue minus COGS minus Expenses where Expenses is the sum of absolute amounts for Expense lines
      - name: gross_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Gross margin ratio equals (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: net_margin_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin ratio equals net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative
      - name: revenue_to_expense_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0, otherwise NULL; unrounded
      - name: month_over_month_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the previous row’s revenue within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the previous value <= 0 or missing
      - name: year_over_year_growth
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change versus the revenue 12 rows prior within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing
      - name: three_month_avg_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Moving average over the current row and the two preceding rows ordered by performance_month; unrounded; may include duplicate months
      - name: revenue_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing revenue to the three-row moving average: Accelerating, Stable, Declining, or Sharp Decline'
      - name: margin_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend bucket comparing gross margin to the three-row moving average: Improving, Stable, or Declining'
      - name: performance_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade based on net margin and revenue-to-expense ratio with defined thresholds: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, or Loss Making'
      - name: revenue_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by department_revenue descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: margin_rank_within_company
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by net_margin_percentage descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps
      - name: revenue_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition average revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: margin_vs_company_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Net margin minus the partition average net margin within (subsidiary_id, performance_month); unitless
      - name: internal_market_share
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Department revenue divided by the partition total revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)
      - name: alert_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Alert based on ordered rules: Revenue Decline Alert, Loss Alert, Efficiency Alert, Margin Alert, else Normal; NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts'
      - name: improvement_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation derived from performance_grade and trend combinations; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Investment guidance based on performance_grade, revenue_trend, and internal_market_share; first matching rule determines the output
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: current_date at model run time; identical across all rows in a run
      - name: operational_metrics_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated with underscores; NULL if any component is NULL; may repeat across locations or classes

rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing. - revenue_trend: 'Accelerating' if revenue > 110% of the three-row average; 'Stable' if > 90%; 'Declining' if > 80%; else 'Sharp Decline'. - margin_trend: 'Improving' if margin > 105% of the three-row average; 'Stable' if > 95%; else 'Declining'. - performance_grade: 'Excellent' when net margin >= 0.2 and ratio >= 2.0; 'Good' when >= 0.1 and >= 1.5; 'Fair' when >= 0.05 and >= 1.2; 'Poor' when > 0; else 'Loss Making'. - Benchmark within each (subsidiary_id, performance_month): - revenue_rank_within_company: ranking by department_revenue descending; ties share rank with gaps. - margin_rank_within_company: ranking by net_margin_percentage descending; ties share rank with gaps. - revenue_vs_company_avg: revenue divided by the partition average revenue. - margin_vs_company_avg: net_margin_percentage minus the partition average net margin. - internal_market_share: revenue divided by the partition total revenue. - Alerts and recommendations (first matching condition applies): - alert_status: 'Revenue Decline Alert' when year_over_year_growth < -20; else 'Loss Alert' when net_margin_percentage < 0 and month_over_month_growth < -10; else 'Efficiency Alert' when revenue_to_expense_ratio < 1.0; else 'Margin Alert' when gross_margin_percentage < 0.1; else 'Normal'. NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts. - improvement_recommendation: 'Urgent restructuring required' for 'Loss Making'; 'Review operations and cost structure' for 'Poor' with revenue_trend='Declining'; 'Focus on cost optimization' for margin_trend='Declining' with revenue_trend='Stable'; 'Increase sales and marketing efforts' for revenue_trend='Declining' with margin_trend='Stable'; 'Scale successful practices' for 'Good' or 'Excellent'; else 'Monitor performance closely'. - investment_recommendation: 'Increase Investment' for 'Excellent' with 'Accelerating' revenue; 'Growth Investment' for 'Good' or 'Excellent' when internal_market_share < 0.3; 'Selective Investment' for 'Fair' with 'Improving' margin; 'Review Investment' for 'Poor' or 'Loss Making'; else 'Maintain Current Investment'. - Final filter: keep only rows with performance_month in the last 12 months and non-NULL department_revenue. - Output order does not affect values: sort by subsidiary_id, performance_month descending, then department_revenue descending. - operational_metrics_id is an MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated; any NULL input yields NULL.

columns.name: subsidiary_id
columns.description: Subsidiary identifier sourced from transactions; grouping key used for window partitions and benchmarking

columns.name: department_id
columns.description: Department identifier from transaction lines; may be NULL; used for grouping and window partitions

columns.name: department_name
columns.description: Department display name from the departments table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved

columns.name: location_id
columns.description: Location identifier from transaction lines; included in grouping; may be NULL

columns.name: location_name
columns.description: Location display name from the locations table; NULL if no match; original casing and spacing preserved

columns.name: performance_month
columns.description: Month start date from accounting_period_ending; only the last 12 months are kept in the final result

columns.name: department_revenue
columns.description: Sum of converted_amount for Income lines per group; sign preserved; 0 when no Income lines exist

columns.name: gross_profit
columns.description: Revenue minus COGS where COGS is the sum of absolute amounts for COGS lines

columns.name: net_profit
columns.description: Revenue minus COGS minus Expenses where Expenses is the sum of absolute amounts for Expense lines

columns.name: gross_margin_percentage
columns.description: Gross margin ratio equals (revenue minus COGS) divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative

columns.name: net_margin_percentage
columns.description: Net margin ratio equals net_profit divided by revenue when revenue > 0, otherwise 0; unitless and can be negative

columns.name: revenue_to_expense_ratio
columns.description: Revenue divided by expenses when expenses > 0, otherwise NULL; unrounded

columns.name: month_over_month_growth
columns.description: Percent change versus the previous row’s revenue within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the previous value <= 0 or missing

columns.name: year_over_year_growth
columns.description: Percent change versus the revenue 12 rows prior within the same subsidiary and department; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when that prior value <= 0 or missing

columns.name: three_month_avg_revenue
columns.description: Moving average over the current row and the two preceding rows ordered by performance_month; unrounded; may include duplicate months

columns.name: revenue_trend
columns.description: Trend bucket comparing revenue to the three-row moving average: Accelerating, Stable, Declining, or Sharp Decline

columns.name: margin_trend
columns.description: Trend bucket comparing gross margin to the three-row moving average: Improving, Stable, or Declining

columns.name: performance_grade
columns.description: Grade based on net margin and revenue-to-expense ratio with defined thresholds: Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, or Loss Making

columns.name: revenue_rank_within_company
columns.description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by department_revenue descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps

columns.name: margin_rank_within_company
columns.description: Rank within (subsidiary_id, performance_month) by net_margin_percentage descending; 1 is highest; ties share rank with gaps

columns.name: revenue_vs_company_avg
columns.description: Department revenue divided by the partition average revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)

columns.name: margin_vs_company_avg
columns.description: Net margin minus the partition average net margin within (subsidiary_id, performance_month); unitless

columns.name: internal_market_share
columns.description: Department revenue divided by the partition total revenue within (subsidiary_id, performance_month)

columns.name: alert_status
columns.description: Alert based on ordered rules: Revenue Decline Alert, Loss Alert, Efficiency Alert, Margin Alert, else Normal; NULL comparisons do not trigger alerts

columns.name: improvement_recommendation
columns.description: Recommendation derived from performance_grade and trend combinations; first matching rule determines the output

columns.name: investment_recommendation
columns.description: Investment guidance based on performance_grade, revenue_trend, and internal_market_share; first matching rule determines the output

columns.name: analysis_date
columns.description: current_date at model run time; identical across all rows in a run

columns.name: operational_metrics_id
columns.description: MD5 of subsidiary_id, department_id, and performance_month concatenated with underscores; NULL if any component is NULL; may repeat across locations or classes

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_transaction_details_original
      description: Original Netsuite transaction line details assembled from core line records joined to related dimensions; includes sign-adjusted amounts and a surrogate key
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__transactions
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounting_periods
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__customers
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__items
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__locations
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__vendors
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__vendor_categories
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__departments
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__currencies
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__classes
      business_logic: 'Build one row per transaction_lines.transaction_line_id: - Start from transaction lines; inner join transactions by transaction_id; inner join subsidiaries by subsidiary_id from the line. - Left join: - Converted amounts on matching transaction_line_id and transaction_id, keeping rows where transaction_accounting_period_id equals reporting_accounting_period_id. - Accounts by line.account_id; and parent account by accounts.parent_id (treated as text). - Accounting periods by transactions.accounting_period_id. - Customers twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Classes by line.class_id; items by line.item_id; locations by line.location_id. - Vendors twice: transaction-side by transactions.entity_id; line-side by line.entity_id. - Vendor categories twice: from each joined vendor’s vendor_category_id. - Departments by line.department_id. - Currencies twice: transaction currency by transactions.currency_id; subsidiary currency by subsidiaries.currency_id. - Deterministic rules: - entity_id takes the line entity_id when present; otherwise the transaction entity_id. - is_transaction_non_posting is the opposite of line.is_posting; remains NULL when is_posting is NULL. - Accounting period fields come from the joined accounting period; transaction_due_date comes from transactions.due_date_at. - Account flags: - is_accounts_payable is true when account_type_name equals ''acctpay'' ignoring case; is_accounts_receivable is true when it equals ''acctrec'' ignoring case. - is_expense_account is true when account_type_name is one of ''expense'',''othexpense'',''deferexpense'' ignoring case; is_income_account is true when it is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case. - If account_type_name is NULL, these flags are NULL. - parent_account_id/name use the parent account when available; otherwise fall back to the current account id/name. - is_account_intercompany and is_eliminate are always false. - Customer fields (id/alt_name/company_name/city/state/zipcode/country/date_first_order/customer_external_id) are taken from the transaction-side customer when transaction_type is ''custinvc'' or ''custcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side customer. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Vendor fields (vendor_category_id/name, vendor_id/alt_name/vendor_name/vendor_create_date) are taken from the transaction-side vendor and its category when transaction_type is ''vendbill'' or ''vendcred'' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side vendor and its category. If transaction_type is NULL, use the line-side. - Location fields come from the joined location; transaction currency fields come from the joined transaction currency; subsidiary_currency_symbol comes from the joined subsidiary currency; department fields come from the joined department; class fields from the joined class; item fields and sales_description from the joined item. - Amounts: - converted_amount is the converted amount using the transaction’s accounting period; its sign is flipped when the account type is ''income'' or ''othincome'' ignoring case; otherwise the sign is unchanged. If the converted amount row is missing, the value is NULL. - transaction_amount and transaction_line_amount follow the same sign inversion rule above, applied to line.amount and line.netamount respectively. If account_type_name is NULL, no inversion is applied. - transaction_details_id is the MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id concatenated with an underscore; inputs are treated as text; NULL when either input is NULL. - All rows from the joins are retained; NULLs from left joins are preserved; no explicit ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Primary line key from transaction_lines.transaction_line_id; one output row per value
      - name: transaction_memo

        description: Line memo from transaction_lines.memo; NULLs preserved
      - name: is_transaction_non_posting

        description: Flag from transaction_lines.is_tax_line; NULLs preserved
      - name: is_closed

        description: Flag from transaction_lines.is_closed; NULLs preserved
      - name: transaction_id

      - name: transaction_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction status from transactions.status
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Transaction date from transactions.transaction_date
      - name: transaction_due_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Due date from transactions.due_date_at
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction type from transactions.transaction_type; drives customer/vendor selection rules
      - name: transaction_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Transaction number from transactions.transaction_number
      - name: entity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Line entity_id when present; otherwise transaction entity_id
      - name: is_transaction_intercompany_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Always false
      - name: is_reversal
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from transactions.is_reversal
      - name: reversal_transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reversal transaction identifier from transactions.reversal_transaction_id
      - name: reversal_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Reversal date from transactions.reversal_date
      - name: is_reversal_defer
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from transactions.is_reversal_defer
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Accounting period end date from accounting_periods.ending_at
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period name from accounting_periods.name
      - name: accounting_period_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Accounting period identifier from accounting_periods.accounting_period_id
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from accounting_periods.is_adjustment
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from accounting_periods.is_closed
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from accounts.name
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type name from accounts.type_name; drives account flags and amount sign
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from accounts.account_id
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from accounts.account_number
      - name: is_account_leftside
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from accounts.is_leftside
      - name: is_accounts_payable

      - name: is_accounts_receivable
        data_type: BOOLEAN

      - name: is_account_intercompany
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Always false
      - name: is_eliminate
        data_type: BOOLEAN

      - name: parent_account_name

      - name: is_income_account

      - name: customer_country

      - name: class_full_name

        description: Class full name from classes.full_name

        description: Item identifier from transaction_lines.item_id
      - name: item_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Item name from items.name
      - name: item_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Item type name from items.item_type
      - name: sales_description

        description: Location identifier from locations.location_id

      - name: location_city

      - name: location_country
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Location country from locations.country; numeric value with NULLs preserved
      - name: vendor_category_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Taken from vendor category of the transaction-side vendor for 'vendbill'/'vendcred' ignoring case; otherwise from the line-side vendor

      - name: currency_name

        description: Transaction currency name from currencies.name

        description: Transaction currency symbol from currencies.symbol

        description: Department identifier from transaction_lines.department_id

      - name: department_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department name from departments.name

      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary full name from subsidiaries.full_name
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary name from subsidiaries.name
      - name: subsidiary_currency_symbol

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Amount converted using the transaction’s accounting period; sign inverted for income/othincome accounts; NULL if no converted amount row matches
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount with sign inverted for income/othincome accounts
      - name: transaction_line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line net amount with sign inverted for income/othincome accounts
      - name: transaction_details_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        - unique
        description: MD5 of transaction_line_id and transaction_id joined by an underscore; NULL when either input is NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: netsuite2_transaction_details_simple
      description: Simplified transaction details per transaction line with basic account, subsidiary, and amount fields plus placeholder accounting period values.
      grain: One row per transaction_line_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts
      - intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts
      - staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_netsuite2__transaction_lines (one row per transaction_line_id). - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__tran_with_converted_amounts on transaction_line_id to bring the converted amount using the transaction accounting period; if missing, set to 0. - Left join intermediate.int_netsuite2__accounts on account_id to bring account_name, account_type_name, account_number, and is_account_leftside; if no match, leave as NULL. - Left join staging.stg_netsuite2__subsidiaries on subsidiary_id to bring sub_id (dimension subsidiary_id), subsidiary_full_name, and subsidiary_name; if no match, leave as NULL. - Amount fields: - converted_amount: the transaction’s converted amount using the accounting period; defaults to 0 when missing; no rounding. - transaction_amount: the line amount; defaults to 0 when missing; no rounding. - transaction_line_amount: the line net amount; defaults to 0 when missing; no rounding. - Accounting period placeholders: - accounting_period_name is the constant ''mock_period''. - accounting_period_ending is the current date at execution time. - is_accounting_period_adjustment and is_accounting_period_closed are both false. - Surrogate key: - transaction_details_id is an MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id joined by a single underscore; if either input is NULL, the result is NULL. - No aggregation, sorting, or de-duplication; all joins are LEFT to preserve the base row cardinality.'
      columns:
      - name: transaction_line_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - not_null
        description: Primary transaction line identifier from the source; one output row per value.
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent transaction identifier from the source line; used to build the surrogate key.
      - name: subsidiary_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier stored on the transaction line (may differ from the dimension value).
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier on the transaction line used to join account attributes.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the accounts dimension; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_type_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account type name from the accounts dimension; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from the accounts dimension; NULL if no account match.
      - name: is_account_leftside
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates the account’s balance-side classification; NULL if no account match.
      - name: sub_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subsidiary identifier from the subsidiaries dimension joined by subsidiary_id; NULL if no match.
      - name: subsidiary_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full subsidiary name from the dimension; NULL if no match.
      - name: subsidiary_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Short subsidiary name from the dimension; NULL if no match.
      - name: converted_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Converted amount using the transaction accounting period; defaults to 0 if missing; no rounding.
      - name: transaction_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line amount from the source; defaults to 0 if missing; no rounding.
      - name: transaction_line_amount
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Line net amount from the source; defaults to 0 if missing; no rounding.
      - name: accounting_period_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Constant value 'mock_period' for all rows.
      - name: accounting_period_ending
        data_type: DATE
        description: Set to the current date at execution time.
      - name: is_accounting_period_adjustment
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Constant false for all rows.
      - name: is_accounting_period_closed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Constant false for all rows.
      - name: transaction_details_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        constraints:
        - unique
        description: MD5 hash of transaction_line_id and transaction_id joined by an underscore; NULL if either input is NULL.

('AcctPay','Expense','COGS')), agg AS (SELECT vendor_id,vendor_name,vendor_email,vendor_category_name,subsidiary_id,sum(coalesce(payable_amount,0)+coalesce(expense_amount,0)) active_months,min(transaction_date) first_transaction_date,max(transaction_date) last_transaction_date,date_diff('day',min(transaction_date),max(transaction_date)) vendor_relationship_days,avg(days_from_due_date) FILTER(WHERE payable_amount>0) avg_payment_delay,count(*) FILTER(WHERE payable_amount>0 AND days_from_due_date>0) overdue_invoices,count(*) overdue_payment_percentage,overdue_invoices,total_payable_invoices,dependency_level,spend_concentration_ratio,relationship_stability,activity_status,vendor_risk_score,CASE WHEN vendor_risk_score>=70
